findings.summary: The blocker from rounds 1 and 2 is resolved on the current tree. src/features/reports/ no longer exists. src/features/report-center/ holds all 8 files. The importers now point to it: src/App.tsx:12-13, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx:23 and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx:13. This unit made no source edit this round because the rename had already been applied outside it. I re-ran the store smoke on the real tree and it passed 8/8.

Not run here: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts` (a capability-wide check owned by integration, not part of this unit's Done when) and the Play dev-link walkthrough (save a PNG logo and a JPG logo, then export the three PDFs). The walkthrough needs the AIOSON Play desktop app, which this environment cannot run.

Unchanged from r1: a plain `pnpm typecheck` can exit 1 before tsc runs. This happens when pnpm's verify-deps step triggers `pnpm install`, whose postinstall `prisma migrate deploy` hits 'database is locked' while a preview holds data/fitpulse.db. I used `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck`.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit passes on the current tree, with the report-center imports in place (local Done when).

8/8 PASS on the real tree: package 0.2.0 (216 files), install 0.1.0, write owner data, update with the current package, boot on PORT/BACKEND_PORT, data identical, 4 new tables, questionnaire files and schema version 2.

BrandSection.tsx calls only @/api/brandApi (getBrand, saveBrand, saveBrandLogo, removeBrandLogo, resetBrand, brandLogoUrl), which is IF-003. It has no direct fetch. ReportSheet comes from @/features/report-center/ReportSheet.

messages.text: The AC-ra-54 rename (src/features/reports -> src/features/report-center) is in place and verified. tsc passes, and `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` passes 8/8 on the real tree. Still open for integration: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts`, and the Play dev-link walkthrough (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta; save a PNG logo and a JPG logo in Configurações -> Seus relatórios; export the three PDFs; check the cover and footer). Stop the preview, or pass --config.verify-deps-before-run=false, so pnpm's install does not hit the locked SQLite database.
